source_header: 一手财报截至2026Q3；行情截至最近交易日2026-11-06。季报未经审计。金额输入为人民币元十进制字符串，模型假设须与已披露事实分开。
units: Amounts CNY 100 million unless key says CNY, pct, days, shares or multiple; pct is percent.

valuation.caveat: Paid DPS belongs to FY2025 and is backward-looking, not a forward promised dividend. TTM is FY2025 + 2026YTD - 2025YTD, never YTD annualisation.

cash_and_quality.cash_caveat: Q3 other current assets lack detailed composition and pledge breakdown. Bills financing are not cash equivalents. No verified Q3 freely distributable excess cash subtotal.
cash_and_quality.debt_caveat: Q3 lease liabilities and right-of-use assets rise sharply; absence of bank borrowing does not mean debt-free. Current noncurrent liability subtotal included conservatively, composition not assumed.
cash_and_quality.turnover_caveat: 273 days and mean opening/closing balances. Company inventory is not dealer inventory, DIO not a channel clearance forecast. Sales cash includes tax and settlement timing; revenue excludes VAT.
cash_and_quality.fcf_caveat: CFO minus cash capex is a simple measure, not owner earnings. New noncash leases do not appear in cash capex. Subtracting all other financing cash outflow is a conservative sensitivity, not a fully identified lease-payment figure.

capex_commitment_notes.note: H1 project table, budget not a new unconditional payment commitment. Cash capex excludes noncash lease additions, some engineering/materials can be settled by notes payable; low period cash capex is not proof of low future investment need.

scenario_terms.profit_base: TTM core profit; EPS0=TTM core profit/current registered shares
scenario_terms.note: Five model-year-end receipts, first earnings=TTM core*(1+g), then compound annually. Years labelled 2027-2031 for scenario readability, not exact declaration/payment-date forecasts. First-year 65% references the last year of the 2025-2027 policy; 2028 onward is an analyst assumption, not policy renewal. Terminal PE values the whole equity; no separate cash, interest income or buyback benefit is added. No double-count of previously paid FY2025 dividend.
